; PROBE (temporary): controlled sleep experiments.
; Polls /tmp/sleeptest.cmd every 2s; on a NEW command string, acts:
;   gotosleep    -> BatteryManager.goToSleep()
;   requestsleep -> BatteryManager.requestSleep()
; Logs every displayState transition + suspend/resume signals with timestamps,
; and the sleep-related delay values at startup. Trigger from shell:
;   ssh root@10.11.99.1 'echo "gotosleep-1" > /tmp/sleeptest.cmd'
; (suffix makes each command unique; the probe acts on prefix match)

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Navigator.qml
	TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: sleepTestProbe
				visible: false

				property string lastCmd: ""

				function act(cmd) {
					console.log("SLEEPTEST act '" + cmd + "' state=" + BatteryManager.displayState
						+ " t=" + Date.now());
					try {
						if (cmd.indexOf("gotosleep") === 0) BatteryManager.goToSleep();
						else if (cmd.indexOf("requestsleep") === 0) BatteryManager.requestSleep();
						else console.log("SLEEPTEST unknown cmd");
					} catch (e) {
						console.log("SLEEPTEST call failed: " + e);
					}
				}

				Timer {
					interval: 2000
					repeat: true
					running: true
					onTriggered: {
						var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
						xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
							if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
							var cmd = (xhr.responseText || "").trim();
							if (cmd === "" || cmd === sleepTestProbe.lastCmd) return;
							sleepTestProbe.lastCmd = cmd;
							sleepTestProbe.act(cmd);
						};
						xhr.open("GET", "file:///tmp/sleeptest.cmd");
						xhr.send();
					}
				}

				Connections {
					target: BatteryManager
					ignoreUnknownSignals: true
					function onDisplayStateChanged(previous, next) {
						console.log("SLEEPTEST displayState " + previous + " -> " + next
							+ " t=" + Date.now());
					}
					function onSuspending() { console.log("SLEEPTEST suspending t=" + Date.now()); }
					function onResumed() { console.log("SLEEPTEST resumed t=" + Date.now()); }
					function onUnsuspended() { console.log("SLEEPTEST unsuspended t=" + Date.now()); }
					function onWokeUp() { console.log("SLEEPTEST wokeUp t=" + Date.now()); }
					function onSleepDelayed() { console.log("SLEEPTEST sleepDelayed t=" + Date.now()); }
				}

				Component.onCompleted: {
					console.log("SLEEPTEST ready. lightSleepDelay=" + BatteryManager.lightSleepDelay
						+ " deepSleepDelay=" + BatteryManager.deepSleepDelay
						+ " powerOffDelay=" + BatteryManager.powerOffDelay
						+ " infiniteSleep=" + BatteryManager.infiniteSleep
						+ " Settings.lightSleepEnabled=" + Settings.lightSleepEnabled
						+ " Settings.idleSuspendDelay=" + Settings.idleSuspendDelay
						+ " Settings.idleToSuspendDelay=" + Settings.idleToSuspendDelay);
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
